craft_notes: Sthāyin: adbhuta-vīra of the Lord's array, limb by limb — weapon-and-ensign song. Time-counted; deaths-death shown; You-close. Rejected: (a) death→end → killed: death dies here. Read aloud: SELF-pow-er-NOOSED … SHOW-us DEATH's-DEATH — YOU.

lines: Self-power-noosed, by knowing-body, I count time;
so by noose-holding show us death's death — You.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nijaśaktipāśavalitaś cidvapuṣā kalyate mayā kālaḥ | pāśadhāraṇavaśāt prathayasi naḥ kālakālas tvam

reads_against.argmap: How is time counted? → Noose-bound time counted; death-of-death shown.
c1_essence: Borne pointed; opposed unopposed in me.
Impassioned cloth cast; bloodied hide told.
Dagger bared splitting; taken-world heroes best.
Noosed time counted; death's death shown.
Hurled to unmake; goad makes plain.
Bow shown, lords arrayed; cause-deer deer-pierced.
